title: 1955 AHSME Problem 1
statement: Which one of the following is not equivalent to \(0.000000375?\)

solutions.text:
The given decimal is \(3.75\times10^{-7}.\) Choices A and B state this directly, while \[ 375\times10^{-9}=3.75\times10^{-7} \] and \(\frac38\times10^{-6}\) \(=0.375\times10^{-6}\) \(=3.75\times10^{-7}.\) But \[ \frac38\times10^{-7}=3.75\times10^{-8}, \] which is ten times smaller.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Rewrite every choice with the same power of \(10\)
